meta.description: Reads the project's attested [Security Insights](https://github.com/ossf/security-insights-spec) file. Fails when it does not link to the project's dependency management policy.
meta.name: Dependency Policy Linked

error.message: Could not detect a dependency policy in the Security Insights file.
error.guidance: Add a changelog entry to your SI file under repository.documentation.dependency-management-policy.

assessment.message: Found a link to the projects dependency policy in SECURITY_INSIGHTS.yml
